verdict.rationale: Kit's official remote MCP server gives AI clients read/write access to a creator's account, including segments and tags (kit-docs-29, kit-docs-20). Kit also says natural-language prompts such as "draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week" become real account actions (kit-docs-5), and broadcasts can be targeted by segment or tag IDs (kit-docs-2, kit-docs-25). However, nothing shows an agent can actually create a new segment with filter criteria from a plain-language description, rather than just reading or referencing existing segments. Missing for 10: documented segment-creation endpoint or MCP tool with filter criteria, an example of turning an audience description into a persisted segment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
